ideal: Qxd4 drops the queen for a knight and lets White threaten mate on g7.
note: Qxg7 mate is real after Qxd4, and Black is also down queen for knight.

ideal: Rxd8 misses Nxd8, when Bxc3+ drives the king to e2 and pockets the a1 rook.
note: Both lines take the queen, so only the king-drive plus rook win explains the miss.

ideal: Qh4 misses Bxg4, which wins a rook and three pawns for a bishop.
note: Rh1 mate is parried by Ke1; the rook-plus-pawns haul is the whole point.

ideal: Qxd4+ misses Rxh7+, which wins a knight and a pawn.
note: The g6 mate is Black's (Nxg6), not White's, so both mate cards point the wrong way.

ideal: Na7 allows 13.Qd4, threatening mate on g7, and drops the c4 bishop.
note: Qxg7 mate forces Bf6, yet the c4 bishop still falls to Qxc4.

ideal: d3 drops the c1 bishop to 7...Qxc1+.
note: Capture with check forces the queen trade and Kxd1, costing castling too.

ideal: Nbd7 drops the g7 pawn after 10.Ne6 Qb6 11.Nxg7+.
note: Nxg7+ wins the pawn with check and drives the king to f7.

ideal: Nxd4 drops a knight and a pawn for a bishop after 5.Bxf7+ Kxf7.
note: The check-capture costs castling and leaves Black down knight-plus-pawn for bishop.

ideal: h6 drops a pawn: 8.Bxh6 threatens mate on g7, forcing Nh5.
note: Qxg7 mate is real, Nh5 parries it, but the pawn still falls.

ideal: hxg6 misses Rxf8+, which threatens mate on f8 and wins a knight.
note: Qxf8 mate after Rf1 forces Nf6, which is then captured.

ideal: Na4 loses a rook and a knight after 9...Bb4+ 10.Bd2 Bxd2+ 11...Qxa1+.
note: The a1 rook falls at once and the a4 knight to Bxa4+; castling loss is minor.

ideal: Re3 misses Rg3, threatening mate on g6, so 36.e6 drops a pawn.
note: Rg6 mate forces e6, and Rxe6+ pockets the pawn.

ideal: Qh8+ drops the queen for a bishop after 15...Ke7 16.Qh4 Bg4+.
note: The g4 mate threat forces Qh4, and the Bg4+ sac still wins the queen.

ideal: Nd2 drops the f2 pawn to 13...Qxf2+ 14.Qxf2 Nd3+.
note: The checks fork king and queen and leave the f2 pawn hanging.

ideal: Na3 misses Qa4+, threatening mate on f7.
note: Bxf7 mate is real but e6 parries it, and bxc6 recaptures, so no knight is won.

ideal: Bd5 misses Bxf7+, which pockets the f7 pawn.
note: Capture with check drives the king to f8 and keeps the pawn.

ideal: Kh8 allows 26.Qxf7, threatening mate on f8.
note: Qxf8 mate is real; no rook is lost anywhere in the line.

ideal: Qa4 misses Nxc6, threatening mate on d8, so Qd6 drops the queen.
note: Rxd8 mate forces Qd6 to block, and Rxd6 takes the queen.

ideal: Qf3 misses Bxg6, threatening mate on h7, so Black must give the queen.
note: Qh7 mate forces Qe1+, and Rxe1 fxg6 still nets queen-plus-pawn for bishop.

ideal: gxf6 misses Qxc5, winning a bishop and a knight for a rook.
note: The sortie wins two minor pieces for a rook; Kxe7 losing castling is a by-product.

ideal: Bc5 drops the e5 knight after 8.d4 Bb6 9.dxe5.
note: The knight falls at once and Qxd5 threatens mate on f7 later.

ideal: Nc6 drops a bishop for a pawn after 9.d5 Qxb2 10.Nb5 Qxa1 11.Nxc7+.
note: Nxc7+ forces Kd8 and the queen hunt nets bishop-for-pawn.

ideal: Nd5 drops a rook and a bishop after 8...Nxd3+ 9.Kf1 Nxd5 10...Bxa1.
note: Two knights for rook-plus-bishop-plus-knight; the castling loss is incidental.

ideal: g3 drops the queen to 7...Bxd1.
note: The queen falls at once; the Ng4 mate is a footnote.

ideal: Bd7 drops a bishop for a pawn after 11.Bxd7+ Kd8.
note: The check forces Kd8 and cxd4 only claws back a pawn.

ideal: Rxg4 misses Qd6, winning the queen and a pawn for a rook.
note: The queen-for-rook win is the point; the g3 mate is parried by Rf4.

ideal: Kxf2 misses Bxf7+, which pockets the f7 pawn.
note: Capture with check drives the king to e7 with lasting exposure.

ideal: Kb1 allows 20...Qb5, threatening mate on b2, and drops a bishop.
note: Qxb2 mate is real but b3 parries it; the forced line still nets a bishop.

ideal: h4 drops a bishop: 24...Bh6 and 25...Qxf3 threatens mate, forcing 26.Rxf3.
note: The g2 mate threat forces Rxf3, and Bxd2 takes the queen.

ideal: Rg7 misses Qc2, threatening mate on f2, so 32.Kf3 drops the c6 bishop.
note: Qxf2 mate forces Kf3, and Qxc6 pockets the bishop.
